What's your return and refund policy?
We accept returns on eligible new, unused, and unassembled items in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery through our online Returns Portal.
For standard returns, you will receive a refund minus a 10% restocking fee and the return shipping label cost. If you selected Enhanced Checkout at purchase, there are no restocking fees or return shipping costs.
Please note that custom-made items, cushion products, swing bed hanging ropes or chains, and assembled items are non-returnable. Once a refund is approved, it typically takes 2 to 5 business days to post back to your original payment method.
